_comment: Extra job sources beyond the companies in companies.json. All are public, no login. Jobright's lists include LinkedIn-sourced postings, so they also cover what you'd find on LinkedIn.
_comment_require_h1b_signal: true = keep only jobs with a real H-1B signal (Jobright's sponsor flag or company H-1B filings, Simplify 'Offers Sponsorship', a visa mention in an HN post, a company in companies.json, or your imported USCIS data). Jobs without one are stored as 'filtered out' so you can still screen them by hand.

hn_who_is_hiring._comment: Hacker News monthly 'Who is hiring?' thread: mostly startups. Only posts that mention visa / H-1B sponsorship are kept.

_comment_discover_boards: When a sponsoring job links to a Greenhouse, Lever, or Ashby board, that company's board is added to the watch list (Sources page) so future runs see all its roles.

board_directory._comment: Watch every company board linked from these public lists (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday, SmartRecruiters). Titles are checked first; full descriptions are read only for postings that pass. Refreshed once a day. Disable single boards on the Sources page.
